item.title: Promesse non tenue sur l’EX90 : pourquoi Volvo offre 1 800 € à ses premiers acheteurs
item.description: Volvo tire un trait sur le LiDAR. Le constructeur suédois annonce l'arrêt définitif de ce capteur sur ses EX90 et ES90, sans possibilité de le retirer physiquement des véhicules déjà équipés. En Norvège, les clients concernés recevront une compensation de 1 800 euros pour des fonctions qui, finalement, ne verront jamais le jour.

item.title: GM redesigned its engineering workflows around AI agents — and tripled its merged pull requests
item.description: Software engineers at General Motors' (GM's) autonomous driving division spend only 15% of their time writing code, according to Rashed Haq, GM's VP of autonomous vehicles, in a recent onstage interview at VB Transform 2026.GM is now using AI agents to accelerate much of the other 85%—including analyzing vehicle data, triaging problems, running experiments and testing potential fixes.The result, Haq said, is roughly three times as many merged pull requests across GM’s autonomous vehicle engineering organization, faster releases and fewer defects escaping into later stages of development.Haq sa...

item.title: Runway couldn't fix a bug in its AI video model, so it turned the bug into a feature
item.description: Runway spent weeks trying to engineer its way out of a stubborn bug: AI-generated avatars would drift off-center during real-time video generation. The fix wasn't a back-end patch — it was a new front-end feature that just worked around the problem. item.title: BMW tente un pari que presque tous ses concurrents ont abandonné : un cabriolet électrique
